name: Riveted Woodworking & Design
old_description: Owner and builder, Althea Tower, provides custom design and handcrafted woodworking services for families and small businesses. Specializing in built in cabinetry, accent walls and more
about:
Riveted Woodworking & Design operates from a shop in Bristol, Rhode Island. The business was founded by Althea Tower, who turned a passion for creating into a custom woodworking venture after years of redoing vintage furniture. Althea, who has a background in sewing and fashion design, describes herself as the woman who dared to dream big. In late 2020, her husband Jason officially joined as a partner, making it a family-owned, woman-led small business.

The company specializes in custom built-in cabinetry and accent or feature walls for residential and small-business clients. All work—design, material selection, cutting, sanding, assembly, and installation—is performed in-house by the two-person team in their Bristol shop. They work with real wood, including hardwoods and reclaimed lumber, producing one-of-a-kind pieces that showcase the natural imperfections of the material.

Riveted serves homeowners and small businesses across southeastern New England. Projects range from mudroom organization systems and home office built-ins to decorative shiplap feature walls that add texture to living spaces. The shop's portfolio includes both residential and light commercial installations.

Althea emphasizes a hands-on, end-to-end experience: every piece is touched by her hands from concept to completion, and the firm prides itself on delivering not just a product but a personal customer journey. The business was honored with a Best of Rhode Island award for Custom-Made Signs, reflecting its commitment to craftsmanship and client satisfaction.

name: Roanoke Electronic Controls
old_description: is a US-based company dedicated to the design and manufacture of quality electronic controls. We offer a turn-key solution, taking your concept through design, prototyping, and production.
about:
Roanoke Electronic Controls (REC) operates from Roanoke, Alabama, where it has delivered custom electronic solutions for over 25 years. The company was established as a U.S.-based manufacturer dedicated to the design and production of quality electronic controls, offering a turn-key service that takes a concept through design, prototyping, and production.

REC provides full-spectrum engineering and manufacturing under one roof. Its in-house capabilities span schematic design, PCB layout, firmware and embedded software development, and mobile app creation for connected products. On the production side, the facility runs automated SMT assembly with two pick-and-place machines, leaded and lead-free wave soldering, selective soldering, through-hole insertion, automated conformal coating (acrylic, silicone, urethane, epoxy), AOI inspection, and a dedicated BGA/QFP rework station. Every board receives 100% electrical testing. The shop supports prototype runs of 5–25 units through production volumes of 10,000+ units, with a sweet spot in the 500–1,000 unit range.

The company serves a range of industries including outdoor cooking (controllers for brands such as Blaz’n Grill Works and Pitts & Spitts), sports timing (electronics for Victory Game Clocks’ wireless scoreboards and play clocks), alternative energy, industrial monitoring, and fitness equipment. Its Navy-certified soldering expertise also makes it a candidate for military and defense-adjacent programs. Customers include startups and OEMs that need direct engineering access throughout the product lifecycle.

REC emphasizes several differentiators: all engineering is performed in-house by the same team that oversees manufacturing, eliminating handoffs; the quality system is registered to ANSI/ISO 9001:2015 with full traceability; manufacturing is 100% U.S.-based, avoiding overseas delays; and customers work directly with engineers rather than sales intermediaries. The firm also highlights its military-grade soldering capability and true turn-key partnership from napkin sketch to production run.

about:
Rockville Steel & Manufacturing Company operates from Gaithersburg, Maryland, where it was founded in 1978 by John T. Steffes. The business remains family owned and operated more than four decades later.

The shop focuses on custom fabrication of steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, covering light structural and miscellaneous metal work. Its team of welders and fabricators handles both shop fabrication and field installation for projects across the Washington metropolitan area.

Primary customers are general contractors and subcontractors in the Washington, D.C., region who need structural and miscellaneous metal components. The company has built a reputation as a reliable subcontractor for commercial and institutional projects.

The firm emphasizes the skill of its welding and fabrication personnel as a key differentiator, positioning itself as a quality-driven partner for light structural metal packages.

name: Roehm America LLC
old_description: RÖHM is a worldwide manufacturer of PMMA products sold under the PLEXIGLAS® and PLEXIMID® trademarks on the European, Asian, African and Australian continents and under the ACRYLITE® and ACRYMID® trademarks in the Americas.
about:
Roehm America LLC, headquartered in Osceola, Arkansas, operates as the Americas division of Röhm GmbH, a global manufacturer of methacrylate monomers and polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) products. The company supplies the Americas under the ACRYLITE® and ACRYMID® trademarks, while its European, Asian, African and Australian markets are served under the PLEXIGLAS® and PLEXIMID® brands.

The company produces a complete range of PMMA-based standard, impact-modified and special molding compounds. Its Bay City, Texas facility runs the world’s first full-scale industrial operation of the proprietary LiMA technology for methyl methacrylate (MMA) production. Processes include injection compression molding and mold-in-color compounding, which eliminates a separate coating step. The global workforce numbers approximately 2,700 employees.

Roehm serves the automotive, electronics, construction and medical technology industries. In automotive, Volkswagen and its supplier Magna use colored PLEXIGLAS® molding compounds for mold-in-color rear spoilers on the ID. Buzz. Construction and outdoor markets use ACRYLITE® SunResist capstock for window profiles, decking, furniture and façades. The company also supplies medical-grade methacrylate materials.

Roehm emphasizes decarbonization through its methacrylate Verbund. The LiMA process reduces the carbon footprint of MMA production. PLEXIGLAS® proTerra grades incorporate mechanically recycled PMMA or sustainably certified raw materials. Mold-in-color manufacturing cuts emissions by avoiding energy-intensive coating. The ACRYLITE® SunResist capstock extends product life in high-exposure outdoor applications.

name: Rogue Industries
old_description: FREE U.S. FIRST CLASS SHIPPING for orders $75+ (after discounts)
about:
Rogue Industries operates from Standish, Maine, where it was founded in 2007. The company began with a single product: a front-pocket wallet contoured to match the curve of a pocket, slim enough to go unnoticed and secured against theft. The founders, whose names are not publicly disclosed, set out to solve the discomfort and bulk of traditional billfolds.

From that original wallet, Rogue Industries expanded into a full line of leather goods, all manufactured in its Maine facility. The product range includes wallets, card cases, and accessories crafted from premium leathers selected to improve with age. The company handles design, cutting, stitching, and finishing in-house, though specific equipment and headcount are not disclosed.

The brand sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce site and has partnered with technology companies such as Tile to integrate Bluetooth tracking into a wallet model. Its customer base is reflected in over 5,000 verified reviews, indicating a broad retail audience seeking minimalist, durable leather accessories.

Rogue Industries emphasizes fit, comfort, and durability as its founding principles. It backs its products with a two-year guarantee and offers free U.S. shipping on orders over $75, positioning its Maine-made goods as a long-term alternative to disposable accessories.

old_description: We are a family owned business in Downtown Medford, OR who love all things camping and outdoors. It all started 13 years ago out of our home shop, where we did embroidery jobs for local schools, businesses, etc. Years later, we were inspired after visiting family in Texas. We noticed how many people wore Texas clothing and thought "well, we're pretty proud of how beautiful our state is too!" Our youngest, Mateo, immediately started sketching designs. February of 2017, we opened our first storefront where we formed wonderful friendships with our customers. Because of our amazing customers and friends, we eventually outgrew the space and expanded in November of 2021. We have been able to expand our own clothing line as well as bringing in other Oregon and PNW small businesses. Oregon is truly a beautiful place to draw inspiration from and we're so thankful to have a space to showcase our love for it.
about:
Rogue Wear by Southern Oregon Embroidery operates from Central Point, Oregon, where it runs a brick-and-mortar storefront The family-owned business traces its origins to a home-based embroidery shop in nearby Medford, started more than a decade ago by the founding family. Their youngest son, Mateo, began sketching designs after a family trip to Texas sparked the idea of creating Oregon-themed apparel.

The company produces its own Rogue Wear clothing line—including overalls, cardigans, hats, and camp goods—and also stocks merchandise from other independent Pacific Northwest brands such as Sendero Provisions. While the business began with contract embroidery for local schools and businesses, it has since expanded into retail, opening its first storefront in February 2017 and moving to a larger space in November 2021. The shop is open Tuesday through Saturday and offers in-person and online sales.

Rogue Wear serves outdoor enthusiasts, campers, and tourists seeking regionally inspired apparel, as well as local organizations that previously ordered custom embroidery. Its customer base includes both walk-in retail shoppers and online buyers across the Pacific Northwest.

The founders say the brand was born from a desire to showcase pride in Oregon’s natural beauty, mirroring the state-specific clothing culture they observed in Texas. They emphasize community relationships and the curation of other small Oregon businesses as core to their identity.

name: Rohrer Manufacturing
old_description: Yes. We are proud to be family-owned and to manufacture every Man Saver Post Driver right here in Prineville, Oregon, USA, since 1997.
about:
Rohrer Manufacturing was founded in 1997 in Prineville, Oregon, as a family-owned business producing the Man Saver pneumatic post driver. The company has remained in Prineville since its inception, manufacturing every unit domestically.

The company designs and builds the patented Man Saver pneumatic post driver, a lightweight, portable tool that drives posts without hydraulics. Its product line includes the 91-R driver for posts up to 2-3/8″ OD, along with a range of accessories: round and T-post adapters, high-pressure upgrade kits, inline oilers, and lubrication oil. All assembly and fulfillment occur at the Prineville facility, with orders shipped primarily via UPS.

Rohrer’s drivers are used on ranches, vineyards, and highway projects, as well as by residential and agricultural fencing contractors and DIY customers. The tool is marketed for one-person operation, enabling a single operator to install fence lines that would otherwise require a crew.

The business was built around the idea that a pneumatic driver could replace manual post driving, cutting labor costs, fatigue, and injury risk. The patented mechanism delivers consistent post placement, and the company emphasizes American-made construction and direct-to-customer shipping as core differentiators.

name: Roltgen's Woodworks
old_description: No matter what your needs or ideas you may have, we are sure that together we will find the perfect solution. We are experts in everything concerning wood, and are always happy to try and to create new things.
about:
Roltgen's Woodworks operates from Piedmont, South Dakota, where sole proprietor Jeff Roltgen designs, drafts, and builds custom furnishings. Roltgen brought over a decade of CAD drafting experience to the venture and adopted digital fabrication methods in 2012, blending traditional hand-tool techniques with modern efficiency.

The shop produces one-of-a-kind furniture pieces and a range of cabinetry, including bath vanities, built-ins, and complete kitchens. Services extend to renovation and remodeling, exterior design, and office furniture. Roltgen handles each project personally, from on-site consultation through final delivery, using a mix of hand tools and digital equipment.

Clients include homeowners seeking heirloom-quality furniture, as well as commercial customers needing custom office furnishings or remodel work. The company was featured in the trade publication FDMC's "Best Practices in Woodworking Technology & Business," highlighting its approach to technology adoption.

Roltgen emphasizes a direct designer-builder relationship, giving customers a hand in the design process and guaranteeing attention to detail that mass-produced items cannot match. The business was built on the premise that personal craftsmanship and modern tools together create genuine, lasting pieces.

about:
Royal Metals Co. has operated as a locally owned, family-run metal distributor and service center in Honolulu, Hawaii, since 1983. The company serves all Hawaiian Islands and the broader Pacific region from its Oahu base.

The business stocks a range of metals including aluminum, stainless steel, carbon steel, galvanized steel, copper, and brass. Beyond distribution, it provides cutting and fabrication services, maintains a large local inventory, and runs daily delivery routes across Oahu with regular shipments to the outer islands. Non-stock items are sourced mill-direct with short lead times from the mainland.

Customers include fabricators, welders, HVAC and roofing contractors, marine and boating professionals, all military bases in the islands, and the general public. The company positions itself as a one-stop metal source for both trade and retail buyers throughout the Pacific.

Royal Metals emphasizes its mill-direct purchasing model to keep pricing competitive, while its family-owned structure and decades-long local presence underpin a service model built on rapid fulfillment and island-wide logistics.
